originalTitle: Moroccan king's letter confirms naming of major highway in honour of Trump
title: A Big New Road in Africa Gets a Special Name!
content:
Hello, my little explorers and curious minds across Africa! I'm your friendly news reporter, ready to share some super exciting news from our amazing continent. Get ready for a story about a big road, a kind king, and a special name!

Meet Our Friend, Morocco!

Did you know that Africa is a very big continent with many, many countries? One of these wonderful countries is called Morocco. It's in the northern part of Africa, and it's famous for its beautiful colours, yummy food, and friendly people.

Morocco has a leader, just like your school has a head teacher, or your town has a mayor. But in Morocco, their leader is a King! His name is King Mohammed VI. He loves his country very much and always wants to do good things for his people.

What's a Highway?

Imagine a very, very long road, much longer than the street outside your house! This super long road is made for cars and trucks to drive really far and sometimes quite fast. We call these big roads 'highways'. Highways help people travel from one town to another, or even from one big city to a far-off place. They help us visit friends, take holidays, and carry important things like food and toys to different places.

Did you know? The longest highway in Africa is called the Trans-African Highway, and it's actually many different roads connected together! It helps people travel all the way across our amazing continent!

A Special Name for a Special Road

Now, for the big news! King Mohammed VI of Morocco has decided to give a very special name to a brand new highway. This isn't just any name; it's being named after a past leader from a country far away, called America. His name is Donald Trump.

Why would a King in Africa name a road after someone from so far away? Well, it's a way to say 'Thank You!' Just like you might say thank you to a friend who helps you, King Mohammed VI wanted to thank Donald Trump for being a good friend to Morocco.

Donald Trump and Morocco's Friendship

Donald Trump used to be the President of America. A President is like the main leader of a country. When he was President, he did something that made Morocco very happy. It was about a place called Western Sahara.

Imagine you have a favourite toy, and you know it's yours. But sometimes, other kids might wonder who the toy belongs to. Western Sahara is a bit like that toy. Morocco believes very strongly that Western Sahara is a part of their country, just like your hand is a part of your body. But for a long time, some other countries weren't so sure about this.

Did you know? 'Sovereignty' is a big word that means who owns a piece of land and who gets to make the rules there. Morocco believes it has sovereignty over Western Sahara.

The Big Help from Donald Trump

When Donald Trump was President, he listened to Morocco. He said, "Yes, I think Western Sahara is a part of Morocco!" This made King Mohammed VI and the people of Morocco very, very happy. It was a big moment of friendship and understanding.

So, to show how thankful he was, King Mohammed VI decided to name this new, important highway the "Donald Trump Highway." It's like giving someone a special award or naming a school building after a very kind person who helped a lot.

Where Does This Road Go?

This brand new highway is very important because it helps people travel easily into Western Sahara. So, not only is it a 'thank you' to Donald Trump, but it also helps connect all the parts of Morocco, including Western Sahara, even better!

Think about it: a nice, smooth road means cars can go faster and safer. This helps families visit each other, and it helps bring things like fresh food and other supplies to different towns. It makes life easier for everyone!

Did you know? Roads and highways are like the veins and arteries of a country, helping everything flow smoothly and connect different parts of the body!

What Does This Mean for Africa?

This story shows us that countries can be good friends, even if they are far apart. It shows that saying 'thank you' is important. And it shows how leaders work together to make things better for their people, whether it's building a big road or making friends with other countries.

It's a happy story about friendship, big roads, and a special thank you from our wonderful African continent. Keep exploring and learning, my little African news fans!
summary: King Mohammed VI of Morocco in Africa has named a new major highway after former US President Donald Trump, as a special thank you for his help regarding Western Sahara.
whyMatters: This is important because it shows friendship between countries, helps people travel easier with a big new road, and connects different parts of Morocco, including Western Sahara, which was a tricky situation before.

originalTitle: Hundreds flee fighting in northern Ethiopia as fears rise of return to civil war
title: Big News from Ethiopia: Let's Talk About Peace
content:
Hello, amazing friends! It's your kid-friendly news reporter here, ready to share some important news from our wonderful continent of Africa. Today, we're going to talk about a country called Ethiopia.

What's Happening in Ethiopia?

Imagine you are playing with your friends. Sometimes, friends might have a small disagreement. But what if the disagreement gets very big? In a country called Ethiopia, some grown-ups are not getting along very well right now. Because of this, some people are feeling scared. They are leaving their homes to find a safe place to stay. Moving away from home can be very tricky. People might have to leave their toys, their beds, and their favorite places behind. They do this to keep their families safe. Hundreds of people are moving. That's like a lot of your school friends, and their friends, all moving at once! It's a big journey for them to find a new, safe place.

Where is Ethiopia?

Ethiopia is a beautiful country. It's in the part of Africa that looks like a horn, we call it the Horn of Africa. **Did you know?** Ethiopia is one of the oldest countries in the world! It has a very long and interesting history, full of ancient stories and amazing places. It's a land of high mountains, big rivers, and friendly people. Just like your town has special places, Ethiopia has many special places too.

Why Are People Moving?

People are moving because there is "fighting." What does fighting mean for grown-ups? It means they are not agreeing and sometimes use loud noises and push each other, but much bigger and scarier than when kids argue. When there's fighting, it's not safe to stay in your home. Imagine if there was a very loud thunderstorm outside your window. You would want to stay inside, safe and sound. For these families, the "storm" is the fighting. So, they go to places where it is quiet and calm. They are looking for safety and peace. These brave families hope to come back home when everything is peaceful again. Everyone wants to feel safe in their own bed.

What is Peace?

Peace is a very special word. It means everyone is getting along. There is no fighting, no yelling, and no unkind words. Imagine a playground where everyone is sharing, taking turns, and helping each other. That's what peace feels like! When there is peace, children can go to school, play with their friends, and sleep soundly at night. Adults can go to work and build nice things. Peace makes everyone happy and safe. It's like sunshine after a rainy day. Everyone loves peace!

What is a Peace Plan?

A while ago, the grown-ups in Ethiopia made a special "peace plan." A peace plan is like a big promise or a set of rules. This plan was made to help everyone stop fighting and start being friends again. It's like when you make a promise to share your toys next time. The grown-ups hoped this plan would bring back sunshine and calm to the country. They wanted peace for everyone. But sometimes, even with a plan, it's hard to make everyone follow all the rules perfectly. It's like when you try to build a tall tower, and one block doesn't quite fit. So, the peace plan is not fully working yet. This makes some people worried that the fighting might start again.

Why is This Important?

It's important because we want all children, everywhere, to be safe and happy. We want them to have homes, go to school, and play without fear. When people fight, it hurts everyone, especially the children. They might miss school or not have enough food or a safe place to sleep. **Did you know?** Many people all over the world are working hard to help bring peace to Ethiopia. They are like superheroes, but instead of capes, they wear kind hearts! These helpers bring food, water, and safe places for families who have moved. They also talk to the grown-ups to remind them about the peace plan.

How Can We Help (Even From Far Away)?

Even though we might be far away, we can still help! We can learn about what's happening and understand why peace is so important. We can also try to be extra kind to our friends and family every day. When we share, when we listen, and when we are gentle, we are helping to make the world more peaceful. Every small act of kindness makes a big difference. It's like planting a tiny seed that grows into a beautiful flower. **Did you know?** When countries are peaceful, they can share ideas and help each other grow stronger. It's like when you and your friends work together on a big puzzle!

Hoping for a Peaceful Future

We hope that the peace plan in Ethiopia will work completely very soon. We hope that all the families who have moved can go back to their homes. We hope that children can go back to school, play in their villages, and sleep soundly in their own beds. Let's send our kind thoughts and wishes for peace to all the children and families in Ethiopia. Remember, peace is possible when we all try our best to be kind and understand each other. Thank you for listening, amazing friends!
summary: Many people in Ethiopia are moving from their homes because of fighting, and everyone hopes a special plan for peace will make things safe and happy again very soon.
whyMatters: It's important because all children and families deserve to feel safe, have a home, go to school, and live peacefully without any fighting.
